description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Raiders released Benito Jones.
items.impact: Jones will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Benito Jones released by Raiders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Raiders signed WR Noah Brown.
items.impact: Brown will hold a depth role in the wide receiver room for Las Vegas.
items.title: Noah Brown signs with Raiders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Cowboys have shown interest in CB Adoree' Jackson.
items.impact: Jackson was with DC Christian Parker in Philadelphia. He is reportedly drawing interest from multiple teams.
items.title: Adoree' Jackson linked to Cowboys

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Bills re-signed LB Otis Reese IV.
items.impact: Reese will compete for a depth role in the linebacker room for Buffalo.
items.title: Otis Reese IV re-signs with Bills

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants signed LB Chandler Martin.
items.impact: Martin will compete for a depth role in the Giants linebacker room.
items.title: Chandler Martin signs with Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings waived LB Arden Walker.
items.impact: Walker will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Arden Walker waived by Vikings

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings signed LB Kenny Dyson Jr.
items.impact: Dyson will compete for a depth role in the linebacker room for Minnesota.
items.title: Kenny Dyson Jr. signs with Vikings

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Panthers QB Haynes King will not play this week.
items.impact: King is continuing to work his way back from a hamstring injury he suffered in the Hall of Fame game.
items.title: Haynes King (hamstring) will not play this week

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Giants waived RB Dante Miller.
items.impact: Najee Harris was signed by the Giants as the corresponding move.
items.title: Dante Miller waived by Giants

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers waived Kion Smith.
items.impact: Smith will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Kion Smith waived by 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers signed OL Nick Zakelj.
items.impact: Zakelj spent time on San Francisco's practice squad and appeared in three games last season. He will compete for a depth role.
items.title: Nick Zakelj signs with 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers signed DL Victor Dimukeje.
items.impact: Dimukeje played four years in Arizona before going to the Giants last offseason. He will compete for a depth role on the defensive line for San Francisco.
items.title: Victor Dimukeje signs with 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders signed LB Krys Barnes.
items.impact: Barnes spent last season with Carolina, bouncing between the practice squad and the active roster.
items.title: Krys Barnes signs with Commanders

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Patrick Mekari underwent a procedure on his back injury.
items.impact: Mekari will miss some time. He is expected to play this season and has not yet made a decision on IR to begin the year.
items.title: Patrick Mekari (back) undergoes procedure

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Tory Horton did not practice on Monday.
items.impact: Horton is likely on a schedule during training camp working his way back from his injury.
items.title: Tory Horton misses practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Trey Smith did not practice on Tuesday.
items.impact: Smith is continuing to work his way through a hip injury.
items.title: Trey Smith (hip) misses practice Tuesday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said CB D'Angelo Ponds is on track to be good to go for Week 1.
items.impact: Ponds is working his way back from a calf strain suffered in late July.
items.title: D'Angelo Ponds (calf) on track for Week 1

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers waived DL Titus Leo with an injury designation.
items.impact: Leo will figure to seek another opportunity when he is cleared.
items.title: Titus Leo waived by 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers signed DL Evan Anderson.
items.impact: Anderson was with San Francisco earlier in the summer. He'll compete for a depth role on the 49ers defensive line.
items.title: Evan Anderson signs with 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts waived OT Bayron Matos.
items.impact: Matos will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Bayron Matos waived by Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts waived WR E.J. Horton Jr.
items.impact: Horton will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: E.J. Horton Jr. waived by Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts placed TE Carson Towt on injured reserve.
items.impact: Towt will likely miss the upcoming season.
items.title: Carson Towt placed on IR

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts signed OL Trey Wedig.
items.impact: Wedig spent time on the Arizona Cardinals' practice squad last season. He'll compete for a depth role on the offensive line for the Colts.
items.title: Trey Wedig signs with Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts signed TE Tyler Moore.
items.impact: Moore was previously with the Giants during training camp. He'll compete for a depth role in the tight end room for the Colts.
items.title: Tyler Moore signs with Colts

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Colts signed OT Roy Mbaeteka.
items.impact: Mbaeteka spent time with the Dolphins and Cardinals last season. He will compete for a depth role with the Colts.
items.title: Roy Mbaeteka signs with Colts

title: Fantasy Player News
